title: Global Impact Models and Calculators
gist: Product page for Oxford Economics' self-service global impact calculators, which estimate economic output, jobs and tax revenues of businesses, capital projects and universities across 185+ countries, 6,000+ geographies and up to 402 sectors. Purely promotional.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics offers online calculators estimating the economic output (GDP/GVA), employment and tax revenues of a business, capital project or university, covering 185+ countries, 6,000+ geographies and up to 402 sectors.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Productized input-output modelling lowers the cost of economic-footprint claims used in planning and lobbying.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics' impact calculators trace a client's spending through global supply chains in one consistent model, producing results at multi-country, national, regional and local-area levels.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Supply-chain multiplier models underpin many corporate and university 'economic contribution' figures — treat such headline numbers as model outputs, not observed data.
insights.locator: One model, from global to local

insights.claim: Oxford Economics positions its calculators as the entry tier of a funnel from self-service tool to consultant-augmented analysis to full bespoke study, all on the same model.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Classic land-and-expand model for consulting firms productizing IP.
